art_direction: 珊瑚黑胶 · 听歌精灵: 浅灰白底，炭黑唱片与珊瑚小圆标，圆标上露出好奇眼睛。
composition_variation: One little vinyl record as a character on a clean near-white very pale gray field. A perfectly readable near-black disc with a slight drawn irregularity, a small coral-red circular center label shifted visually only a hair off-center for a charming handmade feel. Two tiny black oval eyes within the coral label look up with gentle curiosity, a short tiny mouth below. One single thin off-white partial groove arc near the upper-left edge of the black disc gives rhythmic life; no other groove rings. The label is large enough for the face to read but leaves a wide black rim. Disc centered, about 61 percent of canvas diameter. Four colors max. No text, spindle hole through face, player, headphones, notes or arms. Refined minimal music spirit.
style_inspiration: Continuing the established minimalist flat-color avatar collection, with newly invented everyday-object characters, restrained palette and generous negative space. Text-only generation; no source or generated image was supplied as binary model input.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected; distinct original object character, readable silhouette, restrained flat palette, no visible text or watermark
